title: Polyoxometalate-loaded reduced graphene oxide-modified metal vanadate catalysts for photoredox reactions through an indirect Z-scheme mechanism
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,639-656
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00535J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Soumita Samajdar, Gajiram Murmu, Maitrayee Biswas, Srikrishna Manna, Sumit Saha, Srabanti Ghosh
The RPOM-based metal vanadate composites exhibit remarkable photocatalytic performance and superior photoresponse owing to the excellent charge migration through an indirect Z-scheme heterojunction with RGO acting as the electron mediator.
